About Wayz Driver Finder

A driver network built on accountability

Wayz Driver Finder connects riders across Naypyitaw with a fixed roster of licensed drivers — each tied to a real base location, a real vehicle, and a real set of routes they've committed to serving.

There's no app to install and no account to create. You search a route, see who covers it, and call them directly to confirm your ride.

Verified Base Locations

Every driver operates from one of 30 fixed hubs across the city.
